scope: Every 20-property pressure runtime snapshot and two nested compilation configuration properties. Not other APIs, diagnostics, final targets or performance/release acceptance.

properties.name: Utc
properties.availability: A successful capture has UTC kind; default struct is not a captured observation
properties.lifetime: Current sample, not a monotonic elapsed-time clock
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: TotalAllocatedBytes
properties.availability: Actual precise managed counter; excludes native allocations
properties.lifetime: Runtime process lifetime, not live/reclaimed/RSS bytes
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: Gen0Collections
properties.availability: Actual runtime count; a measured zero is valid
properties.lifetime: Runtime process lifetime
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: Gen1Collections
properties.availability: Actual runtime count; a measured zero is valid
properties.lifetime: Runtime process lifetime
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: Gen2Collections
properties.availability: Actual runtime count; a measured zero is valid
properties.lifetime: Runtime process lifetime
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: TotalPauseMilliseconds
properties.availability: Actual runtime duration, not wall time or a percentage
properties.lifetime: Runtime process lifetime
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: TotalAvailableMemoryBytes
properties.availability: Null when memory.Index <= 0
properties.lifetime: Associated completed-GC observation
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: MemoryLoadBytes
properties.availability: Null when memory.Index <= 0
properties.lifetime: Associated completed-GC observation; not exclusive process bytes
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: HighMemoryLoadThresholdBytes
properties.availability: Null when memory.Index <= 0
properties.lifetime: Associated completed-GC observation
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: TotalCommittedBytes
properties.availability: Null when memory.Index <= 0
properties.lifetime: Associated completed-GC observation; not NAM charge
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: HeapSizeBytes
properties.availability: Null when memory.Index <= 0
properties.lifetime: Associated completed-GC observation, not current live objects
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: FragmentedBytes
properties.availability: Null when memory.Index <= 0; actual zero preserved
properties.lifetime: Associated completed-GC observation
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: LargeObjectHeapBytes
properties.availability: Null when memory.Index <= 0 or generation slot 3 is absent
properties.lifetime: Associated completed-GC observation; not all pinned/large native storage
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: ProcessWorkingSetBytes
properties.availability: Actual successful OS sample; failures propagate rather than fabricate zero
properties.lifetime: Current process sample; shared and private pages; no peak claim
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: ProcessCpuMilliseconds
properties.availability: Actual successful OS sample; failures propagate
properties.lifetime: Process lifetime across all threads, not CPU percent
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: ProcessorCount
properties.availability: Actual positive runtime value, not physical CPU count
properties.lifetime: Runtime startup value; not dynamically refreshed quota
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: Cgroup
properties.availability: Each nullable nested field has independent availability; not process-exclusive storage
properties.lifetime: External hierarchy lifetimes and reset rules; see cgroup registry
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: GcConfiguration
properties.availability: Only actual runtime-provided entries; no missing key is synthesized
properties.lifetime: Independent captured dictionary; values used by GC, not merely requested environment
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: CompilationConfiguration
properties.availability: Empty strings mean absent requested variables, not an effective JIT setting
properties.lifetime: Current environment sample; runtime may already have fixed settings
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: LastCompletedGcIndex
properties.source: The same GCMemoryInfo.Index used by all completed-GC fields
properties.availability: Null when memory.Index <= 0
properties.lifetime: No monotonic cross-kind ordering guarantee; background/foreground completion can differ
properties.consistency: Sequential cold capture, not an atomic process transaction; GC fields share one supplied GCMemoryInfo identity.

properties.name: TieredCompilation
properties.availability: Absent variable is empty; no inferred enabled/disabled/default state
properties.lifetime: Environment at capture, not necessarily effective startup/JIT state
properties.consistency: Two separate environment reads, not atomic

properties.name: TieredPgo
properties.availability: Absent variable is empty; no inferred enabled/disabled/default state
properties.lifetime: Environment at capture, not necessarily effective startup/JIT state
properties.consistency: Two separate environment reads, not atomic
